packageRules.description: Keep cli/golangci-lint.mod on its own branch. A Renovate artifact update receives the whole branch config, inherited from whichever upgrade sorts first, so a shared branch would let this modfile impose its goGetDirs on cli/go.mod — and would run only one modfile's post-upgrade task. One branch per modfile keeps every rule pointed at the file it names.

Keep cli/gotestsum.mod on its own branch. A Renovate artifact update receives the whole branch config, inherited from whichever upgrade sorts first, so a shared branch would let this modfile impose its goGetDirs on cli/go.mod — and would run only one modfile's post-upgrade task. One branch per modfile keeps every rule pointed at the file it names.

Keep cli/buf.mod on its own branch, and regenerate the proto stubs after a bump. buf is a generator, never imported: the emitted code links google.golang.org/protobuf, which stays in cli/go.mod, while buf's own graph does not.

Tidy cli/go.mod after a Go bump so go.sum gets the module-content (h1:) hashes, not just the /go.mod hashes; without it any job that compiles cli/ fails with `missing go.sum entry`. This works because each Go modfile has its own branch (see the rules above), so cli/go.mod is the only upgrade on its branch and the option reaches it. Do not merge those branches back together: a Renovate artifact update reads the branch config, which is inherited from whichever upgrade sorts first.

customManagers.description: Keep the a-novel-kit/workflows action pins in the repocfg governance caller templates current. Renovate's built-in github-actions manager only scans real .github/workflows/ files, not these CLI templates, so without this manager the pins go stale and `a-novel repo update` re-deploys an outdated (or load-broken) action version fleet-wide.
